- Goal for the deep dive: validate latency/throughput targets on a representative request profile and agree on a mutual action plan (PoC scope / timeline).

Can you prioritize the three candidate 90-minute slots below? I booked placeholder times in our calendar pending availability:

1) Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:30 AM ET (preferred for our infra leads)
2) Wed Sep 8, 2:00–3:30 PM ET
3) Thu Sep 9, 11:00–12:30 PM ET

Also: we typically run the session from a Zoom room for recordings and screen-sharing, but we can use Google Meet if you prefer SSO integration. Please let me know which bridge you prefer and who from your side will attend (engineering + security recommended).

Attaching a one-pager with an initial PoC scope that we mentioned.

Next-step ask: confirm one slot and the attendee list by end of week, and I’ll send a calendar invite with the chosen bridge and agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.
